title: Add a logger with a log section in the manager
notes: JSON-lines log in userData, rotated across 5 files of 5 MB (25 MB total). Main writes; the renderer sends over log:write, reads with log:read, and gets live updates via log:appended. Fifth manager section "log": rows newest first, level and text filter, Enter opens the entry. Logs errors (every failureText), app/project/pane/agent lifecycle, card moves, ships, worktrees and board CLI writes. Never pane output, typed text or command arguments.

comments.body: PR #81 open: JSON-lines log in five rotated 5 MB files, a log section in the manager with a filter, failures and lifecycle events logged. Not done: board-kind errors log as error; command-screen runs not logged.

Merged PR #81 (v1.16.0): application log in five rotated 5 MB JSON-lines files with a log section in the manager. Two review rounds. Follow-up: a project opened without a .dashboard folder gets no board watcher, so board command moves there go unlogged until the board is opened.
